about.title: About
about.heading: About tooli
about.intro: tooli helps students in Tunisia learn with less stress and more confidence.

why.title: Why we built it
why.text: Good help shouldn’t depend on where you live or how late it is. tooli puts an AI tutor, the best partner courses and top professors in one friendly place.

what.title: What you can do
what.text: Ask any question and get a step-by-step answer, follow partner courses with your progress saved, and book private classes with VIP professors.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: A small team of students and teachers from Monastir who wish this existed when we were preparing the bac.

contact.title: Contact
contact.heading: Contact us
contact.intro: A question, an idea or a problem? We read every message and answer within two working days.
contact.whereText: Monastir, Tunisia. Working on tooli from the POLYTECH campus.
contact.help: Need help with your studies right now?
contact.helpText: The AI tutor answers day and night, step by step.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Short and honest: what we keep, and why.

demo.title: This is a demo
demo.text: For now tooli runs without a server: your name, settings and progress are saved only in this browser. Clear your browser data and they’re gone.

store.title: What we will store
store.text: Your account (name, email, a securely hashed password), your profile, language, progress, bookings and tutor chats, only to make tooli work for you.

never.title: What we never do
never.text: We never sell your data and never show you ads based on it. You’ll be able to download or delete everything from your settings.

vip.title: Learn faster with tooli VIP
vip.subtitle: Private classes with the best professors in Tunisia, a revision plan made for you, and a tutor that never sleeps.
vip.pricesNote: Prices in Tunisian dinars, per month. Cancel anytime.
vip.notifiedText: You’ll be the first to know when {{plan}} opens.

cancel.a: Yes. Plans are monthly with no commitment: cancel from your settings and you keep VIP until the end of the month you paid for.

pay.a: Online payment is coming soon, by bank card (Tunisian and international) and e-dinar. Until then, you pay VIP professors directly after each class.

professor.a: An experienced teacher hand-picked by tooli for their results and reviews. You book private classes with them at times that suit you.

refund.a: If something goes wrong in your first 7 days, contact us and we refund the month, no questions asked. Unused private hours can be moved to the next month.

parents.a: Yes: the Intensive plan sends a weekly progress report to a parent. Family plans for several children are on the way.

dialog.title: Online payment is coming soon
dialog.text: We’re setting up secure payment by card and e-dinar for the {{plan}} plan ({{price}} / month). Leave us a sign and we’ll let you know the day it opens. Until then, you can already book VIP professors and pay them after class.
